reported_entry: Normal F5 / Run Project; menus respond while simulation time stops around 308 seconds.
diagnosis: Initial Rear.advance_time settlement can exceed the unchanged 4000 us cooperative allowance. The previous pre-interval check then returns without advancing any time, repeating indefinitely under sustained load. The user log retained physics/tick/settlement calls but almost no clock notifications. This is a load-dependent starvation condition, not a fixed 308-second stop.
change: Require one positive fully settled interval before cooperative-budget yielding, unless the caller explicitly requested a planning stop. Keep elapsed remainder and existing transaction ordering, Pause, explicit endpoints and all performance ceilings.
tradeoff: The allowance is cooperative, not a hard interrupt. An atomic interval can exceed it. This restores liveness; remaining costs still require optimization for 60 FPS.

evidence.scope: Preserved user log; checksum in logs/freeze-308/objective.json.

evidence.result: New deterministic slow-initial-settlement regression fails before the fix; repeated positive requests make zero progress.
Five headless live guards pass, including deliberate 6 ms initial settlement against 4 ms allowance and actual worker arrival at t=2 before yielding; retained remainder reaches t=10.
One 330-real-second normal full-world 1x endurance case passes, same session, clean audit, no errors/skips. No fixture fast-forward.
All eighteen training domain/read guards pass.
All twelve foreground logistics/report checks pass.

Twelve pointer/query cases reported: eleven pass, one functional failure. Sustained pointer motion ends with an out-of-bounds preview and transform mismatch; its peak measured frame was 12.195 ms. This is not a performance-limit failure; unresolved native input issue, not dismissed as an OS effect. Pending post-placement phase is retained.
Actual root editor imports headlessly, exit 0; inspect stderr for engine errors.

remaining: Prototype completion, full repeated ordinary production-to-frontline supply acceptance, independent domain-clock migration and strict 60 FPS remain incomplete.

references.use: Measure and retain actual frame costs; liveness is separate from performance acceptance.

source_parity.result: All 220 production/project files in the native 330-second source manifest still match the current root byte hashes. Later edits changed tests, test launchers and documentation only.
